title: Langfuse Secret API key: one-property twin (public-prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix is that of a public sibling identifier rather than the secret. Legacy mutation notes: sk-lf- replaced by pk-lf-, the public-key namespace Langfuse documents as safe to expose in browser code; the UUID body and context are unchanged. Twin of "Langfuse Secret API key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of langfuse-secret-key-dotenv: sk-lf- replaced by pk-lf-, the public-key namespace Langfuse documents as safe to expose in browser code; the UUID body and context are unchanged. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
